title: What We Wear
objectives: Say and write sentences that use new clothing words correctly
Use describing words (adjectives) to add detail: a red T-shirt, yellow socks
Use “This is” for one thing and “These are” for more than one
Read a text about clothes in the UAE and answer questions
Use quotation marks to show the exact words a person says
Write letters that are the same size and shape

vocabulary.definition: things you wear on your feet when you go out
vocabulary.example: My new shoes are black and shiny.

vocabulary.definition: a top with buttons and a collar
vocabulary.example: My dad wears a blue shirt to work.

vocabulary.definition: a soft top with short sleeves and no buttons
vocabulary.example: I wear a red T-shirt to play football.

vocabulary.definition: one long piece of clothing that girls and women wear
vocabulary.example: She wears a yellow dress to the party.

vocabulary.definition: soft clothes you wear on your feet inside your shoes
something you wear on your head
vocabulary.example: This hat protects my face from the sun.

vocabulary.definition: you carry your things in it
vocabulary.example: I put my books in my blue bag.

vocabulary.definition: strong shoes that cover your feet and ankles
vocabulary.example: We wear boots when it is cold.

vocabulary.definition: sports shoes for running and playing
vocabulary.example: I wear my trainers in PE.

vocabulary.definition: trousers made of strong blue cloth
vocabulary.example: My brother likes his blue jeans.

vocabulary.definition: a long white robe that men and boys wear in the UAE
a short coat that keeps you warm
vocabulary.example: This jacket keeps me warm in winter.

vocabulary.definition: clothes that cover each of your legs
vocabulary.example: People wear long trousers in winter.
Wear warm clothes when it is cold.
In winter, the weather is cool in the UAE.
People wear light clothes in summer.
Her dress is cool and colourful.

vocabulary.definition: nice to wear; it feels good on you

sentences.text: In winter, the weather is cool in the UAE.
People wear warm clothes like jackets and long trousers.
In summer, the weather is very hot and sunny.
People wear light clothes to stay cool.
This hat protects my face from the sun.
"I like your colourful shirt," says Hessa.

grammar.title: This is / These are
explain: Use This is for ONE thing.
Use These are for MORE THAN ONE thing.
Shoes, socks, boots, jeans and trousers come in pairs, so we say These are.

practice.explain: Jeans are like trousers: we say These are.

grammar.title: Describing words
explain: Describing words (adjectives) tell us more about a thing.
They tell us the colour, size or feel: red, big, warm, comfortable.
The describing word comes BEFORE the thing: a red T-shirt.

practice.prompt: Find the describing word: This jacket is warm.
Find the describing word: She has a colourful dress.
In winter, I wear a ___ jacket.

grammar.title: Speech marks “ ”
explain: Speech marks (quotation marks) show the exact words a person says.
Put “ at the start and ” at the end of the words they say.
Then write who said it: says Hessa.
examples: "I like your colourful shirt," says Hessa.

practice.prompt: Which sentence uses speech marks correctly?
"My boots are warm," says Ali. What words does Ali say?
"This dress is colourful," says Mariam. Who is talking?
Speech marks go around the words a person says.
Where does the speech mark go? ___I love my new trainers," says Omar.

reading.title: Mariam's Two Trips
paragraphs: In January, Mariam and her family go to Jebel Jais. It is the highest mountain in the UAE. The weather is cold there.
Mariam wears a warm jacket, long trousers and boots. Her brother Saeed wears a woolly hat. "These boots are very comfortable," says Mariam.
In July, the family goes to the beach in Abu Dhabi. It is very hot and sunny. Mariam wears a light, colourful dress and a big hat. The hat protects her face from the sun.
Saeed wears a T-shirt and shorts. "I like your colourful hat!" says Saeed.

questions.prompt: Where does Mariam go in January?
What is the weather like on the mountain?
Mariam wears boots on the mountain.
Saeed wears a dress at the beach.
questions.explain: Saeed wears a T-shirt and shorts.

questions.prompt: Why does Mariam wear a big hat at the beach?
choices: to protect her face from the sun
questions.answer: to protect her face from the sun

questions.prompt: Which word in the text means “nice to wear”?
Who says, “I like your colourful hat!”?
Which clothes are good for cold weather?

items: The family goes to Jebel Jais.
Mariam wears a warm jacket and boots.
The family goes to the beach.
